svg.title: From UDP bytes to the Transport struct
svg.desc: The 37-byte UDP datagram carrying the book's DNS query, 32 bits per row: source port 51000, destination port 53, length 37, checksum, then the 29-byte DNS message. The Transport struct gets protocol Udp from the IP header, both ports, the payload, and the UdpPacket in details.
